title: Jarvis v2 Mobile App
goal: Build a voice-first mobile companion app using React Native + Expo that mirrors the Jarvis web UI, supports offline mode, and syncs agent tasks via the API.

tasks.title: Define feature parity matrix between Jarvis web UI and mobile app (screens, components, interactions)
Design offline-first data architecture: identify which data sets must be cached locally (tasks, agent configs, conversation history)
Evaluate and select local persistence strategy (e.g. SQLite via expo-sqlite, MMKV, or WatermelonDB) for offline sync
Define API sync contract: endpoints, delta-sync vs full-sync, conflict resolution strategy, and authentication flow
Create low-fidelity wireframes for core screens: Home, Agent Task List, Voice Interaction, Settings, Sync Status
Choose and document voice engine strategy: native device STT (expo-speech / Voice API) vs third-party (Whisper, Deepgram)
Scaffold Expo project with TypeScript, configure ESLint, Prettier, absolute imports, and folder structure
Set up navigation structure using Expo Router (tab + stack navigators) matching planned screen hierarchy
Implement authentication module: token storage with expo-secure-store, login/logout flow, token refresh logic
Build API client layer with Axios/fetch wrappers, interceptors for auth headers, error normalization, and retry logic
Set up local database schema and ORM layer for offline storage of tasks, agents, and conversation logs
Implement background sync service: queue mutations when offline, replay on reconnect, handle conflict resolution
Configure global state management (Zustand or Redux Toolkit) with slices for tasks, agents, voice, and network status
Build Voice Interaction screen: microphone button, live transcript display, waveform animation, send-to-agent pipeline
Implement STT integration (selected engine) with permission handling, silence detection, and error states
Build Agent Task List screen with real-time status indicators, pull-to-refresh, pagination, and offline badge
Implement Task Detail screen: view/edit task, see agent logs, trigger re-run, and manual sync button
Build Home/Dashboard screen mirroring Jarvis web UI widgets: active agents, recent tasks, quick-voice shortcut
Implement push notifications for agent task completions and errors using expo-notifications
Build Settings screen: account info, voice engine preferences, sync interval, offline storage usage, theme toggle
Implement TTS (text-to-speech) for agent responses using expo-speech with configurable voice and rate settings
Write unit tests for API client, sync service, and conflict resolution logic using Jest
Write integration tests for offline→online sync flow using mocked network conditions
Conduct manual voice UX testing on physical iOS and Android devices across noisy and quiet environments
Perform accessibility audit: VoiceOver/TalkBack compatibility, tap target sizes, color contrast
Run performance profiling: JS bundle size, cold start time, memory usage during voice recording sessions
Execute end-to-end tests with Detox covering critical user flows: login → voice command → task sync → notification
Configure EAS Build for iOS and Android with separate development, staging, and production build profiles
Set up EAS Update (OTA) channel strategy for hotfixes without full store resubmission
Prepare App Store and Google Play store listings: screenshots, descriptions, privacy policy, microphone permission justification
Configure CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions) for automated build, test, and EAS submission on merge to main
Instrument app with crash reporting (Sentry) and analytics (PostHog or Amplitude) for production monitoring

risks.description: Voice recognition accuracy degrades significantly in noisy environments or with non-native English speakers, leading to poor UX for the core feature
risks.mitigation: Prototype both native STT and Whisper API early in Phase 2; implement manual text input fallback on the voice screen; allow users to switch engines in settings

risks.description: Offline sync conflict resolution is complex and may corrupt task state if multiple devices edit the same agent task while offline
risks.mitigation: Define a clear last-write-wins or server-authoritative conflict strategy during Phase 1 architecture review; implement full audit log and a visible conflict resolution UI

risks.description: Apple App Store review may reject or delay the app due to microphone permission usage justification or background processing entitlements
risks.mitigation: Write explicit NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and background mode justifications early; review Apple Human Interface Guidelines for voice apps before submission

risks.description: React Native / Expo SDK version incompatibilities with chosen native modules (SQLite, Voice, Notifications) may cause build failures
risks.mitigation: Lock all native dependencies to tested versions in Phase 2 setup; maintain a compatibility matrix; evaluate bare workflow vs managed workflow tradeoffs before coding begins

recommendedNextAction: Schedule a half-day architecture workshop to produce the feature parity matrix, finalize the offline sync strategy, and select the voice engine — these three decisions gate every subsequent phase and must be resolved before any code is written.
